description: This file contains internal utility functions for handling Unicode encoding conversions, including UTF-16 to code points, surrogate pair conversions, and symbol font code point remapping within the PDFsharp library.

classes.name: UnicodeHelper
classes.description: A static class providing internal functions for Unicode handling, including surrogate pair processing and code point conversions.

methods.name: Utf32FromString
methods.description: Converts a UTF-16 string into an array of Unicode code points, handling surrogate pairs and optional ANSI coercion.

methods.name: SymbolCodePointsFromString
methods.description: Converts a string into an array of code points suitable for symbol fonts, using a remapping function.

methods.name: ConvertToUtf32
methods.description: Converts a surrogate pair into a UTF-32 code point, returning 0 for invalid pairs.

methods.name: IsInRange
methods.description: Checks if a character falls within a specified range.
